content: Healthcare providers are advised to evaluate individuals with diabetes for potential sleep health issues. These issues may include difficulties in falling or staying asleep that are associated with diabetes-related symptoms, the demands of diabetes management, or anxiety related to blood glucose levels. It is recommended that individuals experiencing such sleep disturbances be referred to specialists in sleep medicine or behavioral health professionals for further assessment and management. Patients with diabetes should be encouraged to implement practices that promote healthy sleep. These practices include maintaining consistent sleep schedules and avoiding caffeine consumption during the afternoon hours to enhance sleep quality and support overall health.
